scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,mobile -c blue,magenta "corepack pnpm dev:api" "corepack pnpm dev:mobile"
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter protecther-api dev
scripts.dev:mobile: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter protecther-mobile start
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter protecther-api build
